[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 36[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6319690][color=#ffffff]Server Move[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

We are once again mentioning the server move thread as it's being updated with the progress made. We have seen a large amount of progress so far, and we can say everything is going well so far. [mention=1] has sadly had a few things in life come up this week which have delayed things a little, but everyone can be sure the progress is still being made with a good amount of progress. Remember Rome wasn't built in a day and good things come to those who wait.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314337][color=#ffffff]The Hack Forums Wiki Returns[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

The Hack Forums Wiki has returned. The site has been under some work recently as the site was sadly left with a load of issues and no one was running the official site. Thanks to everyone within the HF news team, the site is now under new leadership and, thanks to [mention=1] allowing the team to start their work on this while maintaining the HF news, the site is back getting some lovely changes and getting updated daily to bring it back to a new modern day Wikipedia with a load of information for everyone to read up on.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Why Testosterone Starts to Decline After 30[/size][/b][/color]


After age 30, testosterone levels in men gradually decline by about 1% per year. This natural drop can affect energy, muscle mass, mood, and sexual performance. Poor sleep, stress, obesity, and lack of exercise accelerate the decline. Strength training, adequate sleep, balanced nutrition, and maintaining a healthy weight can naturally support testosterone levels. Early awareness helps prevent long-term metabolic and cardiovascular risks.

[color=#00369B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

Protect your focus like it’s your most valuable asset—because it is.
Distraction feels harmless in the moment, but repeated small leaks of attention drain long-term progress. Set clear priorities each day. Do the hardest task first. Limit noise—digital and social.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6320399]💰 100,000 Bytes Contest 💰 $250 Value : Upgraded Members Only[/url] By [mention=5418830] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

[mention=5418830] is hosting another 100,000 bytes giveaway again for upgraded members of the site. This time the giveaway is ending on the 8th of March 2026. This will allow everyone plenty of time to get a chance to enter. The user has hosted a few of these giveaways now and every time the winner has always been a lucky person, will you be the next?

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6319739]10,000 Bytes Contest - Upgraded Members Only[/url] By [mention=5568595] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

[mention=5568595] is hosting a 10,000 bytes giveaway that will be ending on the 1st of march 2026. The giveaway is a simple one where all you will need to be at least L33T or higher, give the max population you can, and quick love the thread and to just drop a post in the thread. This way you could get yourself a nice little 10,000 bytes for your time. The giveaway is also in relation to the new group "The Brotherhood 2026" Which you will find more details about within the group section this week.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6291080]Secrets Member Upgrades![/url] By [mention=727139] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

A site member known as [mention=727139] is hosting a giveaway where you could get upgraded for free. This might be a great way to enter the previously mentioned giveaway in this thread. To enter this giveaway, all you need to do is post to enter and be a member of the site for more than a month. The member has already upgraded a few users and the giveaway is still going. So feel free to check out the thread and see if you get lucky enough to get a free upgrade.

[size=xx-large][color=#00D9FF]▸[/color][/size] [u][b][size=x-large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6320283]Fuck, Marry, Kill: HF edition[/url][/color][/size][/b][/u]
[size=small][color=#888888][b]by [mention=4931690] [/b][/color][/size]

A classic Lounge-style chain thread that instantly turned into chaos (in the best way). [mention=4931690] kicks it off with a simple FMK format, then the replies spiral into meme-worthy one-liners, callouts, and the inevitable "rules clarification" as people keep tagging the next trio. It even mutates into a "Hack, Rob, or Kill" twist midstream, which makes the whole thing feel like a live improv game. Pure HF energy: low stakes, high banter, and surprisingly readable even if you don’t know everyone.

[hr]

[size=xx-large][color=#00FF88]▸[/color][/size] [u][b][size=x-large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6320413]Whats a Random Skill Youre Surprisingly Good At?[/url][/color][/size][/b][/u]
[size=small][color=#888888][b]by [mention=2207123] [/b][/color][/size]

A simple prompt that pulled out a bunch of unexpectedly wholesome answers. People drop everything from "reading way above average" to "reading body language," "building box forts (model kits)," storytelling photography, and even the cursed superpower of always losing at gambling. [mention=2207123] keeps the thread moving with quick reactions, so it reads like a clean scroll of personality snapshots.

[hr]

[size=xx-large][color=#FF6B00]▸[/color][/size] [u][b][size=x-large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6320316]Forester: Game Alpha demo - Making it with Codex for Mac (Web Based / HTML/JS)[/url][/color][/size][/b][/u]
[size=small][color=#888888][b]by [mention=4931690] [/b][/color][/size]

A fun devlog-style share where [mention=4931690] posts a playable alpha demo and breaks down what’s already in: gathering, crafting, potions, simple combat, procedural map vibes, and planned tiers for items/abilities. The best part is the vibe—this isn’t framed as "big launch soon," it’s framed as "I'm building something my wife would love," which makes the whole thing feel genuine and creative instead of salesy. [i]If you like small web games, crafting loops, or watching a project grow in public, this is a cool peek.[/i]

[hr]

[size=xx-large][color=#FF00FF]▸[/color][/size] [u][b][size=x-large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6320391]4 Years Vape Free[/url][/color][/size][/b][/u]
[size=small][color=#888888][b]by [mention=5738679] [/b][/color][/size]

A straight-up win post, and a helpful one too. [mention=5738679] shares what actually worked over the long haul: replacing the habit (sunflower seeds / candy), breathing to replicate the "deep hit" ritual, and therapy to ride out cravings instead of fighting them blindly. Another member replies with the real struggle (quitting for months then relapsing), and the thread stays supportive instead of preachy. [i]Short thread, but it hits - especially for anyone trying to quit and needing practical ideas, not just "be stronger."[/i]

[hr]

[size=xx-large][color=#FFD700]▸[/color][/size] [u][b][size=x-large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6320408]Hi I'm new here and here is how I found you![/url][/color][/size][/b][/u]
[size=small][color=#888888][b]by [mention=5738909] [/b][/color][/size]

An entertaining newcomer intro that’s basically "how I fell down the rabbit hole." OP explains they were exploring local AI tools, ended up hearing about HF through that, and joined while trying to get their first posts to unlock chat. The replies are welcoming, and the thread has that classic "new member energy" where they're curious about communities, learning resources, and even experimenting with Linux in the future. [i]It’s a good reminder that people still discover HF the old-school way: by wandering the internet looking for interesting corners to learn in.[/i]
[/align]
